requirements.intro: PNG stores every pixel exactly and supports transparency, so it suits graphics, screenshots and anything you will keep editing. For ordinary photos a PNG is usually several times larger than the JPG it came from.

rows.label: Compression
rows.value: JPG: Lossy: some detail is thrown away each time it is saved. PNG: Lossless: pixels are stored exactly.

rows.label: Transparency
rows.value: JPG: No. Transparent areas become a solid colour. PNG: Yes, full transparency.

rows.label: Best for
rows.value: JPG: Photos, and anywhere that needs maximum compatibility. PNG: Screenshots, logos, graphics with text or sharp edges, images that need a transparent background.

rows.label: Compatibility
rows.value: JPG: Opens everywhere: every browser, phone, app, printer and upload form. PNG: Opens everywhere.

requirements.notes_h3: Before you convert JPG to PNG
notes: Converting to PNG does not bring back detail the JPG already lost. It stops further loss: a PNG can be opened, edited and saved again without getting worse each time.
Expect a bigger file. If you only need a smaller photo, use the image compressor instead.
A JPG has no transparency, so the PNG will not have a transparent background either. Remove the background in an editor first if you need one.
Use PNG when a site or app asks for it, when you plan to edit the image further, or for graphics with text and sharp edges.

how_to.title: How to convert JPG to PNG
how_to.step1_text: Select or drag in one or more JPG files. They are read in your browser, not uploaded.
how_to.step2_text: PNG is already selected on this page. You can switch to another format if needed.
how_to.step3_text: Click Convert Image. Each image is redrawn and saved in the new format on your device.
how_to.step4_text: A single image downloads directly; several images download together as a ZIP.

items.q: Will converting JPG to PNG improve quality?
items.a: No. The PNG keeps exactly what is in the JPG, including any compression artefacts. What it adds is that further edits and saves will not reduce quality.

items.q: Why is my PNG bigger than the JPG?
items.a: JPG throws away detail to save space; PNG keeps every pixel. For photos that usually makes the PNG several times larger.

items.q: Can I convert several JPGs at once?
items.a: Yes. Select or drop multiple files. One file downloads directly; several download together as a ZIP.
